text: よわい　ポケモンでも　いっしょうけんめい　そだてれば　いいこと　あるさ！

structure.jp: よわい　ポケモンでも
いっしょうけんめい　そだてれば
structure.en: if you raise it with all your might

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: Changing a verb's ending to ば means 'if you do it'. そだてれば = 'if you raise it'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing means 'even if it is that'. よわいポケモンでも = 'even a weak Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜さ
patterns.explanation: さ at the end is a breezy, confident way to state something, mostly used by men. あるさ = 'there will be, you know'.
